summary: Frontend-only regression testing of Services page bug fix (fetchCategories parsing array response). Logged in as olena@example.com via /master/login. /master/services now loads correctly with all 7 service cards, category badges (Манікюр, Педикюр, тест), and the custom categories section 'Ваші категорії: тест'. Add service dialog opens with all fields; category dropdown lists Манікюр, Педикюр, Подологія, тест. 'Нова категорія' dialog opens with category-name-input. Edit dialog pre-fills existing service name. All master navigation routes (Огляд, Записи, Клієнти, Послуги, Розклад) load without JS errors or blank pages. No 'Cannot read properties of undefined' error observed.

integration_issues.flow: Master dashboard load (not this bug's scope)
integration_issues.issue: Console shows 403 'Помилка завантаження статистики майстрів' on /master/dashboard — masters stats endpoint returns 403 for a logged-in master. Doesn't break the page but pollutes console.

action_items: Optional: investigate 403 on masters statistics endpoint when logged in as a master (dashboard) — unrelated to services bug fix.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminServices.js fetchCategories() correctly handles both array and legacy object responses; DEFAULT_CATEGORIES preserved. Robust fix.
AdminServices.js is 432 lines — approaching the split threshold; consider extracting Service Dialog and Category Dialog into subcomponents in a future refactor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Services bug fix is verified. Login route is /master/login (not /login). Master stats endpoint returns 403 for master users on dashboard — may need attention if scoped as a bug.
rca of the issue: Frontend expected response.data.all_labels but backend returns a flat array of category objects. Fix maps array → {key: name} with DEFAULT_CATEGORIES merged. Verified working end-to-end.
